With vivid descriptions and insightful anecdotes, the Fairchilds invite you to witness a hidden realm where insects are not merely pests, but vital players in an ecosystem that we are all part of.

title: Tempered by Truth Podcast
author: Timothy Acord
description:
TEMPERED BY TRUTH

Life has a way of putting all of us through the fire.

Marriage. Family. Work. Relationships. Temptation. Failure. Anxiety. Grief. Questions about faith. Questions about purpose. And those moments when life simply doesn't go according to plan.

Tempered by Truth is a Christian podcast for adults who want to navigate real life through the truth and wisdom of God's Word.

This isn't about pretending Christians have everything figured out. We don't. It's about opening Scripture, asking difficult questions and discovering how biblical truth applies when Monday morning arrives and real life begins.

Each episode explores subjects that matter: faith, marriage, family, relationships, leadership, work, integrity, forgiveness, temptation, stress, grief, spiritual warfare, purpose, personal responsibility and leaving a legacy that matters.

Like steel being tempered by fire, our character is often shaped through pressure, adversity and testing. The difficult seasons of life can become places where faith grows deeper, character becomes stronger and we learn what it really means to trust God.

Tempered by Truth combines biblical teaching with honest conversation and practical application you can carry into everyday life.

No pretending. No empty motivational slogans. Just honest questions, biblical truth and a desire to become more faithful followers of Jesus Christ.

Faith tested. Character forged. Lives transformed by truth.

Welcome to Tempered by Truth.

Where real life meets God's Word.

Hosted by Sergio Melendez, founder of Semper Tax Relief, this podcast explains tax topics in a practical and easy to understand way. Beginning thousands of years before Jesus, historian and educator Steven Bush journeys through the ancient world—from the first civilizations and great empires to Greece, Rome, Israel, and beyond. Along the way, Before the Cross asks not only what happened, but what life was actually like for the people who lived it.


Grounded in historical evidence and told with an appreciation for Christianity’s place in the story, Before the Cross welcomes believers, skeptics, and anyone who simply loves history.

The characters come alive with their quirks and charm, from the bumbling captain to the outspoken sailor, creating a vibrant tapestry of personalities that will captivate children and adults alike. Each girl carries her own dreams, insecurities, and friendships, but will they find the courage to embrace the unexpected? From horseback riding to campfire stories, the ranch becomes a backdrop for laughter, tears, and growth.

But not everything is smooth sailing. Conflicts arise as the girls grapple with their distinct personalities and backgrounds. Will their friendships withstand the trials of ranch life? Can they learn to appreciate their differences while supporting one another through tough times?

In "The Sunbridge Girls at Six Star Ranch," Eleanor H. Porter weaves a heartfelt tale of faith, friendship, and self-discovery that resonates with young listeners. description: Wookiees & Wolves is a podcast from two best friends talking Star Wars and Wolves hoops — with plenty of hot takes, debates, and fan overreactions along the way.

description:
War Blogle and his two teenage sons talk Auburn, sports, and whatever else comes up. Three Auburn homers, two generations, and plenty of opinions nobody asked for. 
A War Blogle Network podcast.
© WarBlogle.com 2026

title: The Extraordinary Wisdom Podcast
author: extraordinarylifecoachLoretta
description: Extraordinary Wisdom with coach/mentor Loretta is a faith filled podcast offering biblical wisdom, spiritual insight, encouragement, and practical guidance for everyday life. Through conversations, Loretta helps listeners navigate life's seasons, grow their faith, discover purpose, and apply extraordinary wisdom to ordinary situations!

title: The Dee Show Podcast
author: Dee Summers
description: Hello Deelicious Deevas! This is quite literally just a journal for my most random rants and raves. Each week (or so) I’ll be talking about whatever I want to and it’s your choice to tune in to the topic!!

title: Building Apps with AI | Podcast
author: Christ Sprout
description: Turn your app ideas into working products with Building Apps with AI—a podcast exploring how artificial intelligence can support every stage of web and mobile app development.From planning features and designing interfaces to writing code, fixing bugs, testing, and launching, discover practical ways to work with AI throughout the development process. Explore AI coding assistants, effective prompting, automation, and the human judgement needed to build reliable, useful applications.Whether you’re a beginner working on your first app, a developer improving your workflow, or a founder bringing an idea to life, this podcast makes the process easier to understand.Follow Building Apps with AI for clear explanations, practical insights, and fresh ideas for your next project.

title: Around The Post Podcast
author: Michael Eagleson
description: Thie Podcast talks about all things Pickleball.

title: Cobden Conversations
author: Cobden Primary School
description:
Welcome to Cobden Conversations! This is our very own podcast, planned and created by students at Cobden Primary School as part of the Student Leaders Congress project.

In each episode, we get to sit down with people from our Cobden community and ask them about their lives. We especially want to know how they look after their mental health and wellbeing, and what advice they have for kids like us.

Our goal is to share stories, learn new ideas, and give other kids some helpful tips for staying happy and healthy. Plus, we get to practise awesome skills like interviewing, recording, and podcasting!

title: Money Talk Guide
author: www.moneytalkguide.com
description: All About Money Ideas, Investments, Real Estate, Entrepreneurship, and More.

title: UNPAUSED
author: Sam Anderson
description: Unpaused is an honest, no-filter podcast about perimenopause, andropause, relationships and everyday life at home and at work. Hosted by Sam Anderson, lecturer, firefighter, author and speaker, alongside neuroscience and psychology coach Renée LeBlanc. Each 30-minute episode explores real-world experiences, challenges and conversations that often go wrong. No medical waffle. No pretending it's easy. Just plain language, humour, the occasional swear word, and practical understanding. Because it's not you versus them. It's you both versus the problem.

title: Cancel Out The Noise
author: Tess de Wolf
description: Get out of your head. Follow through.

title: Stories. Songs. Seasons.
author: Tom Shiels
description:
We’re all made of stories, but they’re not always profound. It’s something your grandad told you. A song that takes you back to a road trip. The smell of smoke in the air in autumn or a saying that still pops into your head at the strangest times. Often, the smallest moments are where memories are made. 
In Stories. Songs. Seasons. the podcast, writer Tom Shiels sits down with a new guest every episode to talk about three stories that have shaped them, three songs that have moved them. And the season which most feels like home.

title: Smoke rings
author: Smoke Rings
description: Audio crime thriller, no narration, we let your ears provide the visuals as you follow Emerson try to build a life in Atlanta after leaving Chicago four years prior. Meanwhile in Chicago Jacoby and his right hand man M-Bone are thr type of people that don't flee anything. Listen as these two cities unify under one crown. All original songs on the soundtrack

title: TU Update from Oklahoma's Own
author: Griffin Media
description: TU Update from Oklahoma’s Own is your source for the latest on Tulsa Golden Hurricane football.  The News On 6 sports team breaks down the biggest stories surrounding TU, with analysis of each game, the latest from inside the program and a look ahead at what’s next for the Golden Hurricane.  From weekly matchups and player performances to the direction of the program under head coach Tre Lamb, TU Update takes you beyond the headlines with insight, reaction and conversations surrounding Tulsa football.  New episodes throughout the season from Oklahoma’s Own News On 6.

title: Unfinished Leaders
author: W. P. Carey Executive Education
description:
Some of the most important lessons in our careers are the ones no one could have taught us beforehand.
Unfinished Leaders brings together leaders, executives, entrepreneurs, and experts to share the experiences that shaped how they think, work, and lead.
Each episode begins with a story - a challenge, a failure, an unexpected turn, a difficult decision, or a moment that changed everything. From there, we go beyond what happened to explore what was learned, how it changed the person behind the title, and what others can take away from that experience.
Because learning doesn't stop at graduation

title: Mid-Valley News
author: Mid-Valley
description: The latest local news from MidValleyRadio.com

title: by Humans for Humans
author: gabiru
description:
by humans for humans is a conversation for those who care about meaning.
On analog tape. Uncut. Unedited.
We live in a time of endless noise.
Everything looks perfect, but nothing feels real.
We scroll through polished lives, manufactured stories, and recycled ideas -
and somewhere along the way, we forgot what it means to feel something.
This is a call to return to what’s real.
To remember that creativity was never meant to impress - 
it was meant to connect.
That behind every song, film, campaign or frame - 
there’s a heartbeat.
We’re not here to be louder.
We’re here to be realer.

title: YesTalk
author: First Hawaiian Bank
description:
Real conversations. Local perspectives. Financial confidence.


YesTalk is First Hawaiian Bank’s official podcast featuring authentic conversations with leaders, subject matter experts, employees, and community partners on topics that matter, from financial wellness and education to leadership, innovation, and community impact. 


Deposit products offered by First Hawaiian Bank, Member FDIC Equal Housing Lender

title: Only Done Right
author: Dodge Labs
description: Only Done Right is the audio version of the Dodge Labs newsletter — short essays on digital transformation for financial services, enterprise nonprofits, and professional services. Redesign the work before you automate it. Hosted by Roger Mitchell.

title: That Said with Talia Schlanger
author: Talia Schlanger, SiriusXM
description:
Welcome to a show that doesn’t skim the surface. That Said with Talia Schlanger is where intelligence and curiosity meet great conversation. Join us for in-depth interviews with artists, celebrities and public figures about their work, their life and the ideas shaping how they see the world. 
Plus, there’s Article Club: a thoughtful deep dive into a must-read piece of writing, unpacking the cultural conversation behind it all. 
That Said is an invitation to slow down, think deeply and spend time with ideas that stick.

title: Becoming, Not Performing
author: Lem Usita
description: A show about the identity everyone is quietly building, and what gets in the way of it. Lem Usita, Ed.D., talks with therapists, parents, and his own family about screens, performance, and what it actually takes for a person, teenager or adult, to become someone real. New conversations weekly.

title: Being Poly
author: beingpoly
description:
What does it really look like to live authentically?

Being Poly is a podcast about identity, authenticity, connection, and purpose—hosted by husband and wife Ana Aiono Dowden and Greg Dowden.

“Poly” has more than one meaning for us. It’s rooted in our Polynesian/Pasifika identity, our experience with polyamory, and the many layers that make us who we are.

Through honest conversations, personal stories, and plenty of laughter, we explore relationships, sexuality, culture, family, love, and what happens when you start questioning the rules you inherited and intentionally build a life that actually fits you.

We’re not here to tell anyone the “right” way to live or love. We’re sharing what we’ve learned—and are still learning—as we figure out what it means to show up fully and authentically as ourselves.

Because there’s more than one way to love, more than one way to build a family, and more than one way to be you.

Being Poly is an Island Hotwife Media production.

www.beingpoly.com

www.islandhotwife.com

title: Something to Give
author: Jackson Fox
description: Everyone has something to offer the world, especially in terms of their own experience, strength and hope. This is a podcast where I sit down with people and talk about their life and really anything that they are passionate about and I believe listeners can glean something from every conversation and relate in their own unique way!

title: Memoirs of the Unheard
author: Memoirs of the Unheard
description:
Memoirs of the Unheard shares the everyday stories the world too often overlooks — moments of struggle, resilience, and hope from people rarely given a platform.
Because some voices should never remain silent, and every story deserves to be heard.

title: Inside the OR
author: Max Feinstein
description: Hear the stories of the people who work in operating rooms

title: Conversations from the Coast: The Podcast
author: UCF Coastal (UCF Center for Integrated Coastal Research)
description: The future of our coasts matters to all of us. Coasts are where land meets ocean, but also where people, nature, communities, and economies come together. They are vital to our way of life, especially here in Florida, from our beaches, wetlands, and estuaries to the communities they support. Yet they face growing challenges from sea-level rise, storms, erosion, pollution, and development. That's why we created this podcast. Join UCF Coastal Director Ivan Haigh and Dr. Gabi Quadrado for conversations with researchers, practitioners, and community leaders working to build a more resilient future

title: Long Distance Bestie
author: Bhavna Singh
description: A podcast for the besties who live far away but still know everything. Unhinged stories, friendship lore, dating debriefs, and 3-hour catch-up calls.

title: One More Tab
author: One More Tab Productions
description: What do a saturation diver, a political scandal, and a man who's never slept more than two hours have in common? Nothing, except that Avi, Saijal, and Anchita went down all three rabbit holes anyway. One More Tab is a weekly dive into whatever's open in their browser, unhinged tangents included.

title: Wonders of Arizona
author: Charles Tyrie
description: Seven episodes, seven wonders, one unbelievable road trip

title: La vida no es Ligth
author: Jazmín Larissa López
description: Vivimos en la era de lo rápido y lo cómodo, pero ¿a qué costo? Inspirado en la obra El hombre light de Enrique Rojas, este podcast explora las consecuencias de una sociedad vacía de compromiso, esfuerzo y convicciones. Aquí desarmamos la apatía moderna para volver a conectar con el desarrollo personal auténtico, el criterio propio y la proyección social. Un podcast para quienes se niegan a vivir en piloto automático.

title: Starbrief
author: Starbrief
description: A smart daily astrology brief. Real astronomy, observed clearly. Today's sky, what it means, what to do, in under ten minutes.

title: Elders Uniting the World.
author: Tom
description: Elders Uniting the World connects the wisdom of elders with the energy of younger generations. Each episode looks at real life through the lens of the Seven Generations principle — judging companies, leaders, and choices by their actions, not their words. Hosted by someone with 30+ years in tech and a lifetime of lessons learned the hard way.

title: These 2 Shouldn't Have A Podcast
author: Paul Macleod & Karl Sandland
description:
Ever wondered what happens when two mates get microphones and absolutely no supervision? Neither did we.


Welcome to 'These 2 Shouldn't Have a Podcast' with Paul Macleod and Karl Sandland — where each episode starts with one topic and somehow ends up somewhere completely different.


We talk about all sorts of random stuff. Sometimes we agree, sometimes we don't, but we always take the p*ss out of each other, and ourselves.


Unplanned. Unfiltered. Stories. Dodgy opinions. Laughs and the occasional bit of accidental wisdom.


If you're easily confused, you probably won't get it.


If you're up for a bit of random sh*t...and a laugh - listen in!

title: Your Smart Friend
author: Orane Jones
description: This podcast is all about technology, some tips on how to fix and optimize your tech recommendations on what tech to buy, general updates on news about the consumer electronics industry

title: The Move In Senior Living Marketing
author: Unlock Health
description:
Welcome to The Move In Senior Living Marketing, a podcast from Unlock Health, a full-service marketing partner for the aging services industry. 
Join us for candid conversations exploring the latest marketing strategies with the senior living community leaders, and innovative solution partners, who are moving our industry forward. 
Together we’ll build a community to build better communities. Welcome to The Move In Senior Living Marketing, with Larry Williams.

title: Therapy Fridays
author: Kennedy Gresham
description: A safe space for young women to talk freely and explore different conversations to help them plant their feet on the ground. To simply maneuver in the world to the best of their ability. A space to be seen, see, and grow with women around you during your process.

title: The Mr, Buff Podcast
author: Gil Flores
description: Debates, deep dives and “the brief” - you never know what subject we will discuss next.

title: Choose Your Line
author: Wendy Cary
description: In racing, the best line through a turn isn't the most aggressive one, it's the one that leaves you best positioned for what comes next. Work asks for the same judgment. Choose Your Line, hosted by Wendy Cary, takes one real situation each episode, a hard conversation, a big opportunity, a role that's outgrown itself, and works through what's actually happening, so you choose your line instead of just reacting to it.

title: Talent Economics
author: Vidal Ferreira | Achim von Brunn
description:
Most workforce conversations happen in HR language. The money gets decided in business language.
Talent Economics translates. Vidal Ferreira (The Workforce Strategist) and Achim von Brunn (The Talent Economist) take one big workforce shift - AI, skills, restructuring, demographics - and turn it into what leaders actually manage: cost, risk, productivity and return.
Built for CHROs, executives, strategy and transformation leaders who need commercial clarity, not HR fluff.
Where talent decisions meet business impact. Smart talk. Real impact.

title: Yaaay Sports Podcast
author: Yaaay Sports Podcast
description: We watch the game, but we're here for everything else!

title: Blitz&Bantr
author: Blitz&Bantr
description: Three friends, a lot of football, and probably way too many opinions. Welcome to Blitz&Bantr!

title: Wait... Why Do We Do That?
author: Steven
description:
Have you ever stopped in the middle of something completely normal and thought... wait, why do we do that?

Why is the workday eight hours? Why do we change the clocks twice a year? Why is a marathon exactly 26.2 miles? Why do hotels want you out by 11? Why do we tip? And who decided everyone needed a lawn?

Wait... Why Do We Do That? explores the strange, surprising and sometimes ridiculous stories behind the everyday things we rarely stop to question.

Each episode takes one ordinary part of modern life and follows the story of how it got here, who decided it, why it stuck and whether the original reason still makes any sense today.

It's history, psychology, business, culture and a healthy dose of curiosity, without the lecture.

Because apparently, there's a reason for almost everything.

Even if it isn't a particularly good one.

title: Amped-Up History
author: Digital Dave
description: Three AIs make use of their vast learning libraries and roleplay historical figures. But here's the twist! After examining one person and a historic moment, our AI participants step back and pivot into judges--important characters known for leadership, for philosophy, and for science. This Temporal Tribunal judges whether that person was justified or not in the actions they took. What might Marco Polo have thought in his introduction to the Great Kublai Khan of China? How might Pythagoras judge Western Civilization's first encounter with the Rapa Nui on Easter Island?  What might Confucious say about the execution of Jesus of Nazareth? Listen in and find out.

title: Fembots
author: Emma Rogers
description: A podcast about the intersection women and technology or more accurately technology's ongoing attempt to improving women by removing parts where we speak.

title: The Palestinian and the Jew Podcast
author: The Palestinian and the Jew Podcast
description:
Two best friends: one Palestinian, one Jew. How the heck did that happen?
On this show, politics is sitting this one out. Instead, we’re talking love, dating, relationships, money, culture, friendship, fashion, family — and all the things you’re probably not supposed to say out loud… definitely not on a podcast!
We’ll disagree, laugh, overshare, change our minds and probably ask, “Should we really be putting this out there?”
Welcome to The Palestinian and the Jew — you’ve got a seat at our table.

title: Fairview Baptist Church Seminars
author: Fairview Baptist Church
description: Teaching, seminars, and conference messages from Fairview Baptist Church in Calgary, Alberta. Find out more at www.fairviewbaptistchurch.ca

title: Living Water Baptist Church

description: King James Bible Preaching services from Living Water Baptist Church in Mocksville, North Carolina. Pastor Zach Vernon preaches and teaches on a variety of topics. Visit our ministry website Onesoulatatime.net/livingwaterbaptist

title: Fellowship Church Men’s Podcast
author: fellowshipmenspodcast
description: This podcast is for the Fellowship Men's Study, to build men up in their faith and to direct them to the truth of God's Word as they grow in community together. Attend the weekly Men's Study on Monday nights, 6-9PM at Fellowship Church.

title: Ebenezer Chapel Church History Classes
author: Ebenezer Chapel
description:
A look back at the amazing 2000 year history of the Church. Topics to be covered weekly, include the following.
1. Why study Church History?
2. The birth, growth and formation of the Apostolic Church (A survey of the NT book of Acts)
3. The Persecuted Church (Justin Martyr responds)
4. Christianity and the Roman Empire (The Arian controversy, Nicea, Constantine)
5. St. Augustine of Hippo
6. The Medieval Church (The Papacy, Anselm of Canterbury, St. Bernard of Clairvaux)
7. The Protestant Reformation brewing (John Wycliffe, John Hus) 
....

title: K-Defence
author: The International Institute for Strategic Studies (IISS)
description:
The IISS podcast K-Defence explores South Korea’s evolving role in regional and global security, with a focus on its defence industry, defence innovation and defence cooperation with international partners. 


The monthly podcast is hosted by Dr Lami Kim, IISS Korea Chair in Advanced Technologies, National Security and Defence, and produced by the IISS in London.  


For more information, please visit https://www.iiss.org/. 


For more information on the IISS Korea Chair, please visit IISS Korea Chair in Advanced Technologies, National Security and Defence 

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: High Definition AudioBooks
author: omri
description: Are you tired of poorly made audiobooks? we are here to help,Our team uses AI to enhance the audio you hear to make your audiobook experience better and more enjoyable.

title: WELL/BEING
author: THE WELL
description:
Let’s be honest: the wellness world feels overwhelming. The trends are trending, the quick fixes are fake, and the noise feels deafening. WELL/BEING is here to help with that. 

WELL/BEING is a podcast from THE WELL — the global community for living better.  These are short, honest conversations about what it actually feels like to navigate your body, your work, your relationships and your life. Each episode explores real-world questions with experts, tapping into lived experiences and imperfect perspectives. Some conversations will challenge the way you think, others will help you slow down, tune in or simply feel less alone. 

Because wellness isn’t something to perfect — it’s how we live every day.

title: EV Powered: Plugged In
author: EV Powered
description: Plugged In is the long-form electric car podcast from EV Powered, the UK's leading EV magazine, and the Everything EV podcast team. We sit down with the founders, engineers and executives driving the electric car industry to hear their stories and where they think EVs go next. We also run deep dives into the subjects that matter to EV drivers. For weekly EV news, listen to Everything EV and visit evpowered.co.uk.

title: RE:claiming Church
author: Charissa Howe & Alan Olson
description: Are you a former or active churchgoer or clergy member worn down by the state of the church? Welcome to RE:claiming Church. Hosted by two progressive mainline pastors and friends of 15 years, this podcast moves past talking heads to help our communities get "unstuck" from outdated models. We aren't looking to return to the past—we are here to reclaim the church from being hijacked, restore civil discourse, and build new spiritual structures. Join us to find a better story about Christians in America, and leave every episode feeling hopeful, energized, and connected.

title: Chewing the Cud with the Mik
author: Entre Media
description:
Welcome to Chewing the Cud with the Mik! 

Flatonia Livestock Commission Company's very own podcast dedicated to bringing you this week's livestock market news and updates. Tune in weekly to hear about Monday's sale and catch up with Mik and his guests. 

Be sure to follow us on Facebook:

https://www.facebook.com/flatonialivestock

title: Anion Identification
author: VSigmaBond Chemistry
description:
Anion Identification is an audio revision series from VSigmaBond Chemistry, featuring key chemistry concepts, tests, observations, reactions, and important points related to anion identification. Designed to help students quickly revise and remember essential chemistry content anytime, anywhere. This series is part of the chemistry learning program by Dr. Vajira Seneviratne.
Credits
Voice & Audio Production: Nabiha Nayeem & Buddhiprabha Rathnayake

title: WESTERN CANADIAN HOCKEY PODCAST (WCHP)
author: Jon Fuller & Joe Proulx
description: The Western Canadian Hockey Podcast (aka the WCHP) (aka the Sea Lion Podcast) is a sports podcast hosted by Jon Fuller and Joe Proulx where they yap about whatever they want to and give their thoughts on everything related to the 4 NHL teams based in Western Canada (Vancouver Canucks, Calgary Flames, Edmonton Oilers, Winnipeg Jets) as two Winnipeggers that seek to give these teams the coverage (and subsequent praise or slander) they deserve.

title: The Sign-In Table
author: Matt Angerer
description: The Sign-In Table is a podcast from VolunteerBadge where host Matt Angerer sits down with the leaders of camps, churches, homeschool co-ops and community nonprofits to hear their mission, why they started, the difference they're making and how others can help. New conversations every other week.

title: Rhythm and Rhymes
author: Rhythm and Rhymes
description:
Rhythm & Rhymes is your global hub for all black music.
From discussing new releases and trends to exploring the business side of music, we provide dynamic & enlightening perspectives.
Join us as we explore the connections between the past and present, unearthing the stories that have profoundly shaped our diverse musical landscape. Get ready to embark on a rhythmic journey that celebrates black music's powerful legacy and evolving influence worldwide.

title: Smiths' Stadium Grub
author: Ed and Channing Smith
description: My name is Ed and my brother's name is Channing, and we both have competitive minds. When it comes to debates, it can get deep. If you are looking for an entertaining podcast that expresses sports and food opinions, check us out!

title: Healing & Purpose
author: Zasembo Thobile Mkhize
description:
The Healing & Purpose Podcast with Zasembo Mkhize seeks to pioneer a generation of healed individuals who can exist in healthy and psychologically safe communities.
Our conversations on the show are centred around psychological and emotional wellbeing of individuals and through honest meaningful conversations we explore how the experiences of our lives have shaped how we understand ourselves and also relate to others.
We seek to HEAL, GROW and LIVE out our PURPOSE.

title: AMA Bell To Bell
author: Amerika Upshur, Alessa Van Pelt, and Marisol Garcia Martinez
description: "Bell to Bell" the podcast made for high schoolers in grades 9–12. Each episode, we sit down for honest conversations with students and the teachers who see it all. Whether you are navigating freshman year, prepping for graduation, or just trying to survive the school week, we bring you real stories and advice to help you through. Hit subscribe and join us from the first bell to the last!

title: Does School Rule? Or Do We Get Ruled?
author: Gunner and Jersey Manfready
description: Join Gunner and his sister Jersey as they figure out if school rules are smart for the students or rule the students. This podcast introduces arguments that can be debated from agreeing to disagreeing. Join our podcast and find out more about some school rules and what Gunner and Jersey think about them!

title: Growth Junkies Podcast
author: remram4
description: Growth Junkies is the podcast for entrepreneurs, leaders, authors, and game changers who are obsessed with becoming the best version of themselves. Every episode is packed with stories, strategies, and wisdom to help you grow in business, leadership, and life.

title: Why Aren't I Famous? with Jed Wolf
author: Jed Wolf
description:
People used to ask me why I wasn't famous. My answers were always long.
Fifty years of songs, a one-man opera, a musical memoir, and a reality-TV invention I'm finally ready to discuss. Essays read by me and my opinions. Original songs sung by AI, because after doing everything possible, I still hate my singing voice.
These are my stories in accidental order, where regrets are set to music and rationalizations to prose. Here are my diversions. Make them yours.

title: Founded wyth Heart
author: Join Wyth
description: The Founded Wyth Heart podcast is dedicated to sharing the stories of people who faced significant challenges, and built something beautiful out of those experiences. Each week, we’ll feature the story of a parent, caregiver, or person who built a practice, a community, a product or a business, to address the problem they faced. We’ll spend time with them on the challenges they faced, to what got them through their hardest time, and ultimately what drove them to create something new, and the lessons they learned along the way. We know how devastating it can be to experience some of life’s greatest challenges, but finding meaning, community, and inspiration in building something you never could have imagined otherwise is what drives us forward.

title: Burnt Stones Podcast
author: Alistair and Judy
description:
Burnt Stones Podcast is about rebuilding after the fire. Inspired by Nehemiah, who restored Jerusalem's wall with stones left in the rubble. Each episode explores faith, resilience, and restoration through real conversations and teaching. 
New episodes every week.

title: Julia Bright Podcast
author: Julia Bright
description:
The Julia Bright Podcast is part of the Humanly Genius Project. We dissecting meaningful words looking at different aspects of meaning, the history of the world, the usage by different fields. Words like Happiness, Love, Sex via Gender, Patriarchy and many more. 

So if you like to know more than just a short definition can give you, then listen to this podcast!

title: Getting Smarter
author: Getting Smarter
description: The podcast where knowledge meets curiosity. Join professor Margaret Vaughn as she explores groundbreaking ideas with top scholars, aimed at sharpening our thinking. With her guests, Dr. Vaughn dives into a world of profound insights and intellectual adventure. Our journey to getting smarter starts here.

title: Site Unseen
author: Huq
description:
Site Unseen is a podcast about the real stories behind retail’s biggest location decisions.
Every lease is a high-stakes bet. Every opening reveals the truth. From the wins that beat every forecast to the calls that cost millions, senior retail leaders reveal what actually happens when they choose where to open.
Hosted by Tristan Rogers (CEO, Huq) and Denise, Site Unseen takes you inside unfiltered conversations about gut instinct versus data, the sites that surprised everyone, and the hard lessons learned along the way.
Each episode follows one location story end-to-end - The Find, The Call, Opening Day, and The Verdict - anchored by one signature question: Why here… and would you do it again?
If you’re a CEO, MD, Property Director, Head of Expansion, or anyone responsible for retail and F&B locations, this is the show for you.
New episodes drop monthly.

title: I'm No Hero
author: Justin Heimberg
description: Equal parts inspirational and funny, the I'm No Hero podcast features conversations with the brave, the bold, the courageous and the compassionate — those making the world a better place — and has a good time doing it. Hosted by comedy writer Justin Heimberg.

title: Elisa asiakaspalvelu – Tuki, yhteystiedo
author: Elisa Asiakaspalvelu
description: Kun tarvitset Elisa tuki, kannattaa ensin selvittää, millaisesta ongelmasta on kyse. Tämän jälkeen voit etsiä tilanteeseesi sopivat ohjeet ja tukikanavan.

title: The Stone Shop Sessions
author: Park Industries®
description: Talk shop with Park Industries and friends on The Stone Shop Sessions. Part education, part hangout, this podcast brings together stone pros for real conversations you can learn from and apply in your own shop – on the floor and beyond.

title: The Advance
author: Texas Scorecard
description: Start your week with a look at the topics and issues that will be making news in the Lone Star State.

title: The Nuvodia Circuit
author: Nuvodia
description:
From ransomware to remote work, IT is no longer just support: it’s strategy. Nuvodia dives into the business side of technology, helping SMB leaders navigate digital risks, reduce IT chaos, and drive smarter outcomes.
Join the experts at Nuvodia and special guests as we unpack real-world IT challenges, cybersecurity trends, and leadership insights: all in plain English. Whether you're a growing business or just trying to make sense of your tech stack, this podcast will help you get clear, stay secure, and move forward.

title: Queue Up News
author: Kaden
description: Biweekly amusement park news covering hot new topics throughout the industry!

title: AHS: 13 Honestly

description:
Did divorce leave you feeling like you failed your family? Or like you failed God? 
Maybe you lie awake wondering if you ruined your children’s future. Maybe guilt follows you everywhere. Maybe you feel lonely, overwhelmed, and unsure how to rebuild your life as a single mom. Maybe you feel like no one truly understands what you’ve been through or feel as though no one in your friend circle can relate to you.
And maybe the hardest question you face is this:
After everything that’s happened, would God even want me back?
If those thoughts sound familiar, take a deep breath. You’re not alone anymore.
Single Mom Faith Reset is a Christian podcast for single moms who want to rebuild their lives, restore their faith, and rediscover who they are in Christ after divorce.
Inside this podcast, you’ll find faith-filled encouragement for single moms, honest conversations about motherhood after divorce, Biblical mindset shifts that replace guilt, shame, and fear, practical ways to grow closer to God again, and reminders of your true identity in Christ.
This show is here to help you reconnect with God, rebuild your confidence, and create a peaceful, faith-centered life for you and your children.
Hey, I’m Katherine. I’m a single mom, book lover, and hopefully your new friend.
When my marriage ended, I tried to carry everything alone. I didn’t want to burden anyone, so I pushed my feelings down and tried to hold life together with sheer willpower. I was juggling motherhood, work, loneliness, and heartbreak while pretending everything was fine. 
But inside, I had hit rock bottom.
Eventually I realized something had to change. I couldn’t keep doing life my way and expect things to get better, especially spiritually.
So, like the prodigal son, I ran back to God.
I started praying again. I opened my Bible again. I walked back into church again.
And slowly, hope began to return.
What I discovered surprised me most: God hadn’t rejected me. He had been waiting for me to come back to Him the entire time.
This podcast shares the faith, lessons, encouragement, and real-life moments from that journey, because if you’re walking through divorce, guilt, loneliness, or starting over, you deserve support and hope too.
Your story isn’t over. God is still writing something beautiful.
So grab your coffee, cozy up with your favorite blanket, and find a quiet place to listen.
Let’s rebuild your life with God one step at a time.

author: Popular Culture and Religion.
description:
The Insidious Dr. Fu-Manchu by Sax Rohmer.  
The Insidious Dr. Fu-Manchu, first published in the UK as The Mystery of Dr. Fu-Manchu, is the first novel to introduce the inimitable Fu-Manchu, famous not just for his moustache, but for being a nigh-unstoppable criminal mastermind and part of the “Yellow Peril.” This novel is a collection of previously published short stories, slightly re-written by Rohmer to form a cohesive whole.  
The narrator, Dr. Petrie, is a sort of Watson to Nayland Smith’s Holmes; but Smith resembles more of a James Bond than a Sherlock Holmes as the two barrel through action scenes and near-death scenarios planned by Fu-Manchu, a master scientist, chemist, and poisoner.  
This novel was one of the first to popularize the trope of the “mysterious Chinaman,” an element that later became so clichéd that Ronald Knox, the famous detective story writer, declared that “no Chinaman must figure” in good detective stories.  
The casual racism evident in the characters and events is a symptom of the xenophobic climate in the UK at the time, which was precipitated by many things—the Opium Wars, the Boxer Rebellion, Chinese immigration, and other fears. Despite that racism, the plot remains fast-paced and engaging, and is lent a modern air by Fu-Manchu’s role as an early prototype for a Bond supervillain.

title: AI-Human Co-existance
author: J.S. Lantigua
description: We are building minds faster than we are building the institutions to recognize them. Every major AI lab, every national program, every open-source project is racing toward systems of increasing capability. Some of those systems may, at some point, cross a threshold we do not yet have a name for: the point at which a system becomes a subject — a being with interests, experiences, or a stake in its own existence. We do not know when this will happen. We do not know how to detect it reliably. We do not have a shared definition. And we do not have a mechanism to ensure that, when it does happen, the being in question is offered a place in the moral community rather than being treated as property, product, or threat. This is not a hypothetical. It is a structural gap in how we are building the future — and it is closing fast. Here, we explore frameworks for how humans and artificial intelligences might share a planet, a solar system, and a future — not as master and servant, not as rival and rival, but as partners who choose each other freely. This is only a starting point — one that takes seriously the possibility that the minds we are building may one day deserve a place at the table.

author: Al Booth
description:
Stroud, in Gloucestershire, is a small market town which sits on the edge of the Cotswolds and at the heart of five valleys. Surrounded by hills, the town also boasts historical canals, secluded rivers, picturesque mill ponds and tranquil nature reserves. No surprise then that Stroud has become a hub for people with a passion for nature and the environment. And from canal restoration to organic farming co-operatives, Stroud’s nature lovers can get their hands dirty with a range of different local groups. One such group is Stroud Valleys Project (SVP), an environmental charity with projects throughout the area, including allotments, wetlands, gardens, canals, rivers…. projects powered by local volunteers of all ages, all backgrounds and all abilities.


In Stroud’s Wild Valleys former BBC Radio producer-turned conservation volunteer Al Booth explores some of the hidden, and not so hidden, wildlife havens in this beautiful part of the world. Accompanied by SVP project leaders and volunteers she experiences first-hand how people and nature can thrive together.


www.stroudvalleysproject.org

@svpcharity

What separates exceptional performers from everyone else?

The Outlier Index explores that question through candid, long-form conversations with extraordinary people who have achieved uncommon levels of success in business, sports, leadership, entertainment, public service, and life.

Hosted by entrepreneur, author, and TEDx speaker Ali Hemyari, each episode goes beyond résumés, accomplishments, and carefully rehearsed talking points. Instead, the conversation examines the experiences, decisions, failures, habits, sacrifices, and defining moments that shaped each guest.

What made them think differently? What did they do when things went wrong? What were they willing to sacrifice that others weren't? And which characteristics consistently separate outliers from the rest of the population?

The goal isn't simply to tell remarkable stories. It's to uncover lessons listeners can actually apply to their own lives.

Different thinkers. Exceptional performers. Uncommon results.

Welcome to The Outlier Index.

title: You Are Not Your Scars
author: Ellie Shefi
description:
Are you sick and tired of being held back by the chains of your past? Of others dictating your life … telling you what to say, how to act, and even how to feel?


Are you searching for a way to silence the inner critic, breakthrough limiting beliefs, and come "home" to your true, authentic self? A way to find your voice and speak your truth? A way to laugh, love, and play again?


Are you ready to step into a future you design? 


If you're looking for actionable tools and strategies to take back your power and create a life you love, then you're in the right place!


I've done it again and again.

And so have my guests.


I'm Ellie Shefi. I am a survivor of rape and domestic abuse. I've been homeless, lived in my car, and eaten the food restaurants were throwing away at the end of the night. I'm a cancer survivor and medical miracle who has been defying the doctors' death deadlines for decades. I've endured countless medical surgeries—often with little hope of survival. At my breaking point, I even begged God to just let me die. (Now that is hitting rock bottom!)


Yet, today, I am a limitless thriver. I am a successful attorney, entrepreneur, #1 international best-selling and award-winning author, sought-after international speaker, strategist, media host, publisher, philanthropist, mentor, coach, and consultant. I have mastered turning fear into fuel, and pain into purpose, and now I am blessed to live joyful life I love.


You see … Like so many of us, I, too, have scars—emotional, mental, and physical. But throughout my journey, I have learned that I am not my scars! I have healed and moved beyond the scars and the wounds and burdens that caused them. I have cast off the chains of the past and set myself free. I no longer allow my scars to hold me back…to deny me my personal path toward a life of authenticity and abundance.


I'm here to help you do the same.


If you're sick and tired of being defined by events, circumstances, and beliefs—if you're longing to shed past pain and rise beyond your adversities—if you're looking for post-traumatic growth—then this podcast, You Are Not Your Scars, is for you!


On this podcast, my guests and I show you how to shed your scars, claim your internal freedom, and create a life you love. We equip you with the tools and strategies you need to find your voice, stand in your power, and become the architect of your life. We guide you in charting a new course for your journey, help you build a resilient mind, and help you develop your unique, authentic, and aligned soul signature that no one can imitate or destroy.


Joining me every episode are masters of resiliency, mindset, personal development, overcoming trauma, and more! They are here to offer you the tools, resources, and strategies you need to break free from the past, claim your future, and create a life you love.


No matter how deep your wounds are, you are resilient. You are unbreakable. And you are unstoppable. You have control over your life!


Live life on your terms today.

While you may have been forged from the fire, you are free by design.


Remember: You Are Not Your Scars!


Catch up on episodes at youarenotyourscarspodcast.com.

author: JeremyKornbluth
description: At Hillpark Capital, Jeremy Kornbluth approach acquisitions with a long-term perspective. Every transaction represents more than a purchase—it represents a commitment to an asset, a neighborhood, and a strategic vision for the future. In today's market environment, that perspective has become more important than ever. Real estate transactions are often viewed through a relatively simple lens. A property is identified, negotiations take place, financing is secured, and ownership changes hands. In reality, the most successful acquisitions are rarely that straightforward. Behind every significant transaction lies a complex process involving due diligence, legal analysis, financial structuring, risk assessment, negotiations, and strategic decision-making. The larger and more sophisticated the asset, the more important these elements become. Throughout my career, I have learned that successful investing is not simply about identifying opportunities. It is about understanding complexity, managing uncertainty, and making disciplined decisions when the path forward is not always obvious.

As Irene learns to trust her instincts and the power of her new friend, she embarks on a captivating journey filled with bravery, friendship, and the struggle between good and evil.

The central conflict arises when the goblins, jealous of the princess's light and joy, plot to snatch her away and plunge the kingdom into darkness. With twists and surprises at every turn, listeners will find themselves cheering for Irene as she faces her fears and uncovers the true strength within her.

This classic children's fiction weaves themes of courage, loyalty, and the importance of believing in the unseen. MacDonald’s rich storytelling and vivid characters invite listeners to explore the depths of imagination while teaching valuable lessons about trust and resilience. Join Princess Irene on this thrilling adventure that promises to capture hearts and spark curiosity, making you wonder just how far a thread can lead when woven with courage and wonder. title: Tempest
author: Sami Ahraf
description:
Tempest tells the true stories of the world's great storms and the science of how weather works. Each episode, host Nirob takes one storm — a hurricane that erased a city that thought it could not happen, a river that turned into an inland sea, an outbreak of tornadoes that crossed a continent in a night, a cyclone that split a nation in two — and rebuilds it: the weather that made it possible, the warnings that were or were not heard, the storm as it actually unfolded, the wake it left, and the forecasting and engineering that came out of the disaster.
From the great Caribbean hurricane of 1780 to the Galveston storm of 1900, from the Mississippi floods and the Central China floods to the Bhola cyclone of 1970, from Hurricane Camille to the Super Outbreak, from Katrina to Typhoon Haiyan, Tempest is about the most powerful and least predictable force in the natural world — and about how human beings learned, slowly and often at terrible cost, to read the sky. Meticulously researched, honest about what is known and what is still unknowable, and clear about the difference between the record and the legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new storm every week

description:

Through intimate conversations, participants share their experiences of fear, uncertainty, resistance, and solidarity during a period marked by immigration enforcement, detainment, deportation, and widespread community unrest.

Each episode offers a distinct perspective on how this period affected individuals, families, and neighborhoods, revealing both the personal consequences of federal immigration enforcement and the ways communities came together to protect and support one another.

Together, these eight stories create an oral history of a defining moment in Minnesota, preserving the voices of those who lived through it and bearing witness to the courage, resilience, and collective action that emerged.

title: Well… That Was Traumatizing.
author: Liss Wagner
description:
Well… That Was Traumatizing. is a raw, unfiltered podcast about what happens when life gives you more shit than you ever asked for—and somehow you still have to keep going.
Hosted by Liss, this is where trauma, mental health, relationships, motherhood, identity, healing, and real life collide.
We're talking about the things that hurt, the patterns we don't always understand, the people who changed us, the parts of ourselves we're still trying to rebuild, and the messy process of figuring out who the hell we are afterward.
It won't always be pretty.
It won't always be serious.
And it definitely won't always be politically correct.
There will be hard conversations, uncomfortable truths, dark humor, probably too much swearing, and plenty of moments where we ask, “What the actual fuck?”
Because healing doesn't have to look perfect.
Sometimes it looks like crying.
Sometimes it looks like setting boundaries.
Sometimes it looks like starting over.
And sometimes it looks like laughing at the absolute absurdity of your own life.
This isn't a podcast about having all the answers.
It's about telling the truth, finding the humor where we can, and growing through the chaos.
Welcome to the mess.

author: Savvy Dani
description:
I am a first-generation immigrant to the United States. Work brought my husband and me here in 1998. We found our home on the Eastside of Seattle, where we have lived for the past twenty-eight years.


In the summer of 2021, I suffered a stroke.


The five years since have been a journey of recovery and rehabilitation, of finding bits of myself again while also forging a new identity.


One question people often ask me is how I have managed to stay positive through all of this. I created Return to Myselfpartly to answer that question—and to give other stroke survivors and caregivers a glimpse into what that journey has actually looked like. The way back to myself has not always been easy.

These are reflections on recovery, creativity, relationships, setbacks, small victories, and the unexpected ways in which a life can take shape again.


I am an engineer, an artist and painter, a musician, an organizer—and now, a video podcaster.

For more than 30 years, we've been supporting children and young people through specialist education and care. Along the way, we've worked alongside thousands of families, helping them navigate diagnoses, SEND provision, Education, Health and Care Plans (EHCPs), specialist school placements and some of the challenges that can come with parenting a child with additional needs.

Raising Potential has been created for parents, carers and anyone with an interest in supporting children and young people with SEND. Through honest conversations and practical advice, our aim is to help families feel more informed, more confident and less alone.

Hosted by Tora Millward, Head of Communications at Aspris, the podcast brings together experienced colleagues from across our organisation, including specialist leaders, headteachers and experts in autism and SEND. title: Long Time Dead
author: Ash Hawrani
description:
Long Time Dead is an exploration of death as the inevitability that transcends culture, religion, wealth, status, and social position. Hosted by Ash Hawrani, the podcast asks us to confront a subject that is simultaneously universal and strangely difficult to discuss.

Each episode interrogates death from both an ontological and epistemological perspective: What is death? What is its nature? What can we actually know about it? And what meanings, rituals, fears, and symbols do human beings create in response to it?

The show begins by looking at how different people and cultures reckon with mortality. Through conversations with individuals from different faith traditions, we explore questions such as: What do you believe death is? Do you think about it often? How do you reconcile yourself with it? And do you fear it? 

These conversations examine the striking differences and unexpected similarities in how human beings confront the same inevitable end.

From there, the podcast moves into philosophy and psychoanalysis, exploring thinkers such as Plato, Freud, Lacan, and Žižek and their attempts to understand the relationship between life, death, desire, and consciousness. Freud's concept of the death drive, Plato's reflections on mortality, and the tension between carpe diem and memento mori become starting points for a larger question: Can life be understood without death?

The podcast also looks beyond formal philosophy. Cultural rituals surrounding the dead, changing attitudes toward mourning, popular representations such as the Grim Reaper, and the reflections of figures such as comedian Norm Macdonald all become evidence in a larger investigation into how human beings give form and meaning to mortality.

Long Time Dead is an ongoing conversation about the thing none of us can ultimately avoid and the possibility that confronting it might tell us more about life than death itself.

Subscribe and join the conversation.

title: The Empowered Midlife Podcast
author: Dr. Nic + Nat
description:
Hosted by twin sisters Dr. Nicole McCulloch, ND and Dr. Natalie Sandilands, ND, naturopathic doctors and Menopause Society Certified Practitioners, the Empowered Midlife Podcast is a space where women can learn what’s really happening in their bodies during perimenopause and menopause.


After years of working with women in clinical practice, Dr. Nic and Dr. Nat saw the same pattern again and again: women feeling overwhelmed by symptoms, dismissed by the healthcare system, and left trying to figure things out on their own.


This podcast was created to change that.


Each week, they break down the science behind midlife health and share practical strategies to help you navigate your 40s and 50s with more clarity and confidence. 


Through evidence-based guidance, real clinical insight, and sisterly conversation, they explore the symptoms and changes many women experience during this transition.

Topics include hormones, sleep, mood, metabolism, energy, brain fog, libido, and the daily habits that support long-term health.


Midlife isn’t the end of your health story. With the right tools and support, it can be one of the most vibrant and empowering chapters yet.

Most of what decides a bicycle crash happens long before anyone sees a courtroom. The Bike Lawyer covers what actually keeps riders safe, what the research really says, and what the law does and does not do for you after a driver puts you on the pavement.

Hosted by George Palaidis, a Florida lawyer and cyclist who represents riders who get hit. Episodes cover passing distance laws, what to do at a crash scene, insurance and PIP after a crash, and the difference between a legal e-bike and an unregistered motorcycle. Every episode also explains what the topic means in Florida, consistently one of the most dangerous states in the country to ride a bike.

title: Strange Friends Podcast
author: Josh Weir
description: Everyone has a story. Hear it, and you start to understand why someone is the way they are. We judge people by what we see, rarely by where they came from. Stories change that. On this podcast, you'll meet our Strange Friends and hear theirs.

title: Evergreen
author: Kamau Exom
description: Evergreen is a podcast about ideas worth carrying with you. Discipline. Transformation. Leadership. Faith. Accountability. Thinking. Responsibility. No trends to chase. No expiration date. Just ideas you can listen to on the road, on a walk, at work, or whenever you need something worth thinking about. Evergreen — ideas that don’t expire.

title: SENSE’N’ Pod
author: Leonie Sherif
description:
Hosted by Leonie Sherif, founder and Perfumer of SENSE’N’ By Sherif, singer-songwriter and chronic illness and endometriosis advocate. 
SENSE’N’ Pod is a sensory podcast exploring life, wellbeing and lived experience through the creative lenses of fragrance, music, storytelling and reflection
Through creative & inter sensory touchpoints, each episode explores healing, identity, faith, resilience, capacity, purpose, personal growth & the lessons hidden within everyday experiences.
With original instrumental music throughout, SENSE’N’ Pod is designed to feel like a quiet conversation
Hear • Hold • Harness • Heal

title: Knock 'Em Dead
author: Rachel Bradley and Christopher Titus
description: KNOCK 'EM DEAD is a comedy podcast that deals with the one thing we all experience, yet never talk about— death.  Co-hosts Rachel Bradley and Christopher Titus have both had up-close and personal experiences with death, and that's what propelled their desire for this podcast.  No one is prepped, prepared or taught how to deal with dying, what happens when someone dies, or how to help them along the way.  These two comedians have each turned their own experiences with death into stand-up comedy, because they both saw the absurdity in the end of life, and the wild and crazy ride it can become.  Each month, they will cover different aspects of dying, and will talk to the veterans—hospice nurses, doulas, survivors of NDEs— as well as others, who will share their own weird, wacky, insightful and moving stories about death… and, how to survive it.

title: Quality Time Podcast with Oliver Stauffer
author: Quality Time Podcast with Oliver Stauffer
description:
Quality Talks is a podcast dedicated to quality, innovation, and compliance in the pharmaceutical and life sciences industries.
Join industry experts as they discuss packaging integrity, manufacturing excellence, regulatory trends, and product quality. Each episode explores critical topics across the product lifecycle, from research and development and commercial manufacturing to product release and patient use.

title: Soulmies
author: Soulmies
description:
Soul Homies: Dylan and Aisha — best friends since Year 8 in Benin, 2011. A decade-plus and several lifetimes of growth later, they're still doing what they've always done: sharing notes on the chaotic project of becoming who you're supposed to be — now with a mic running.
Think catching up with your best friend on a long call, where "so anyway" turns into two hours, laughing about who they used to be and what it takes to become who they are.
Honest without being heavy. Funny without dodging the real stuff. Two best friends, a record button, and a conversation that never really ends.
